data.name: Arpana
data.gender_notes: Arpana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arpana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arpana’ which means ‘to offer’ or ‘to desire’. It is a name that represents one’s deepest desires and aspirations. In Hindu mythology, Arpana is the name of a goddess who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees. The name Arpana carries the meaning “Desire, Wish, Aspiration” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arpana usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, wish, aspiration and live with faith, good character and purpose.
